original_value: Decorative smart desk lamp with a woven-fiber shade, warm/cool white tuning, and ambient motion-reactive lighting for home studios and reading nooks. Includes USB-C power input, touch controls, and a dimmable LED module.

result.paraphrase: Decorative smart desk lamp featuring a woven-fiber shade, adjustable warm and cool white lighting, and ambient motion-reactive illumination for home studios and reading nooks. It includes USB-C power input, touch controls, and a dimmable LED module.
